caption: 🕷️🥞 Day 2/13 of toddler-friendly Halloween treats & food! Today we’re making a Spooky Spider Web Pancake! 👻🎃 You can use whatever pancake recipe your toddler loves, but I used the simple pancake recipe I’ve been making since my toddler was a baby: 🥞 Pancake * 1 small banana * 1 egg * 2 tbsp all-purpose flour * 2 tbsp milk Mash the banana, add everything else and mix together. Cook in a little olive oil over low-medium heat until golden on both sides. Let cool before decorating! 🕸️ For the spider web: Add Greek yogurt to a bag and snip a tiny corner. Pipe 2 circles around the pancake, then add 4 lines going across to create the web. 🫐 For the blueberry spider: Cut a blueberry in half for the body. Take the other half, cut it into thin slices and add 3 little legs on each side. 🕷️ Such a simple way to make breakfast a little more fun and Halloween-y for your toddler! 🧡 Follow along for Day 3/13! 🎃 #toddlerhalloween #toddlerbreakfast #toddlerpancakes #toddlerfood #toddlerrecipes
